tagline: Two sides. No game server. Destroy the other base — against the computer, or a friend from one link.
description:
Two sides, no game server. The computer thinks on this device, or a friend joins from one link. The board lives in this file, so you can close it and come back.

Red and blue take turns. Each side has a tinted home and a house inside it. On your turn you do one thing: place a piece from your hand around your home, slide one already out, or turn a tank. Tanks shoot in a straight line the way they face — the beam lights up when you tap one. A shield stops the other side's shots. Infiltrators steal a tank or a shield if they stand next to it. A mine blows up anything next to it except a shield. You may not leave your own pieces in harm's way. Destroy the other house and you win.

Pass the phone for two people in the same room, or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices. Red sits one side, blue the other.

An unofficial port of Thinktank by averycrespi.
